lines.speaker: ilse
lines.text: Meridian wants to endow us. Buildings, a wall, a stipend for twenty years, and a seat on our own board for one of theirs. I have been staring at the paper for two days and I have not turned it over once.

lines.speaker: ilse
lines.text: We took their money. There will be a wall by spring and a name on the gate that is not ours, and I will not stand here and pretend that costs nothing.

lines.speaker: ilse
lines.text: We refused. We will be cold for twenty years and we will own every cold inch of it, and in the spring I expect I shall be told so by somebody.

lines.speaker: ilse
lines.text: If you have an opinion, say it plainly. I have had two days of people agreeing with me and it has been no use at all. I would rather be argued with.
